title: Relay-Capable Exact-Head Windows/Android Certification
selected_by_owner: Strict successor after owner-approved PCV-03 decomposition and PCV-03E completed_verified closeout; ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH supplies no interstitial override.
objective: Certify the CURRENT service-first PCV-03F Session implementation on exact-head installed Windows x64 and Android ARM64 clients: independently verified canonical account/device identity and recipient-bound Campaign membership; PostgreSQL authoritative durable Session truth; authenticated HTTPS launch/commands/bootstrap; advisory WSS event delivery with durable sequence/checkpoint reconnect and authenticated polling fallback. Prove idempotent accepted commands, ordered/gap-safe recovery, current authorization and hidden-before-publication projections across real devices. PCV-03F/PCV-03 remains in_progress until actual independent installed proof and governed validation pass; no automatic NSER relay/TURN closeout or PCV-04 activation.
acceptance: Current service-first integration must consume canonical A3/A5 and PCV-03A..03E authority without a second Campaign/Session history, privilege boundary or transport-owned game state.
Authoritative PostgreSQL Session commands/bootstrap use authenticated HTTPS; WSS events are advisory only, and authenticated polling supplies a bounded fallback when WSS is unavailable.
Run focused A3/A5/P9/SMB/VTI and PCV-03 regression/security/recovery checks, then exact-head Linux/Windows source and native build gates.
Generate Windows x64 NSIS and Android ARM64 packages from the exact candidate head with verified manifest hashes, installation identity, protocol/schema compatibility and migration evidence.
Installed evidence binds independent Windows/Android runtime and package identity to distinct fresh account/device credentials, not self-reported wire or fixture metadata.
Verify real Campaign create/locate/invite/join, recipient-bound authorization and single-click normal connectivity without copying raw bearer, SDP/ICE, tokens or signaling documents.

Produce causal distinct-device receipts for first accepted command, duplicate retry/conflicting reuse, temporary transport disruption, authenticated reconnect, ordered/gap-safe event delivery, checkpoint catch-up and no duplicated authoritative effects.

Reject stale/revoked authorization, actor spoofing, invitation replay, wrong Campaign scope, hidden-field leakage and cross-account cached information; confirm authenticated polling does not bypass these checks.

Fresh installed Windows↔Android acceptance and exact-head verifier must pass before PCV-03 parent closes; PCV-04, release/store/billing/production credentials and unrelated successors stay unauthorized.
boundaries: Certify service-first PCV-03F through the canonical A3/A5 launch/session ports and PCV-03B/D owner semantics. Maintain a single authoritative PostgreSQL Session command/event/checkpoint history; no duplicate authoritative owner or parallel recovery ledger.
Reuse BIP-01 package-production machinery. PCV-03F strengthens exact-head package manifest/install identity and causal certification evidence rather than becoming a second package builder.

Regenerate Windows x64 NSIS current-user installer and Android ARM64 direct-install APK only from the exact candidate head; manifest binds source head, build reference, application id/version, artifact SHA-256/size, protocol/schema compatibility and migration ids/checksums.

Windows evidence binds installed executable payload SHA-256 and records unsigned-beta explicitly unless signing is actually enabled. Android evidence binds applicationId/versionName/versionCode/targetSdk, APK hash, ABI set and signing-certificate digest/history.

Installed Windows and Android proofs require distinct fresh challenges and distinct registered non-exportable A3 device credentials; peer JSON self-report or human affirmation alone cannot certify install identity.

Causal real-device proof must distinguish ordinary join from authenticated reconnect, accepted command from duplicate retry, WSS drop from polling fallback/resume, player event batch and acknowledgment from command receipt, gap-safe catch-up, stale-authorization denial, invitation reuse denial, actor spoof denial and hidden-before-publication filtering.

Sensitive invitation/resume secrets, device private keys, authentication tokens, hidden payloads and cross-context private data are excluded from certification evidence; legacy SDP/ICE material must never be exposed if any historical adapter remains.
Do not enable Tauri updater, public/store distribution, production credentials/signing, billing/subscriptions, paid acquisition or public launch in PCV-03F.

Device/platform network permissions must match the actual service-first HTTPS/WSS behavior; old direct-LAN or forced-TURN Android guidance is historical only and does not independently authorize new permissions.
PCV-04 gameplay remains unauthorized until PCV-03F closes and the PCV-03 parent is completed_verified.
Use milestone-level OPS3 state only; no activity-journal instrumentation.

Owner-directed Session UX repair stays authorized for create/locate/invite/join and one-click authenticated service connectivity; the normal path must not require manual signaling or raw tokens, and may not change canonical Campaign/Session ownership.

Nakama/PostgreSQL and forced-relay work remain historical evaluation/proposals; the owner-selected current implementation is the provider-neutral PostgreSQL-centered service-first route. A future adapter or transport change requires its own governed acceptance/migration, never two concurrent ledgers.

Campaign codes are locators, not secrets or authority. User ids are connection targets, not authentication proof. A3/A5 authorization and recipient-bound invitations still gate access underneath one-click UX.

Use canonical A3 identity/device and A5 Campaign/Session launch/permission owners, plus PCV-03B/D command, event and recovery contracts. Installed causal proof comes from actual independently installed Windows/Android paths; mocks or generated evidence cannot certify it.
